segments.title: Station Sign-On and Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer, requests noodles, and wishes viewers a happy Halloween.

segments.title: Pre-Show Chat and Halloween Costume Reveal
segments.notes: Case and Kendall banter about One Piece trivia, subscriber gifts, and reveal their couples costume as Pink Panther and Inspector Clouseau; Hype Train interrupts with a freestyle about 'piss webs.'

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle: Piss Webs
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed for a surreal Halloween rap about webs made of piss and spiders made of piss, derailing the pre-show flow.

segments.title: News Desk: Refugee Cap, Sudan, Prince Andrew, Cash Patel, NZXT, Saudi Sky Stadium
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins Case for the news block covering Trump's 7,500 refugee ceiling focused on white South Africans, the Sudan civil war, King Charles stripping Prince Andrew of titles, FBI Director Cash Patel using a government jet for his girlfriend's wrestling event, NZXT hit with civil RICO, and Saudi Arabia's $1 billion sky stadium render.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday with Trent: Stone Cold Fox, Scream 7, Dracula, Palestine 36
segments.notes: Trent screens four trailers including a 70s-style action film, Scream 7, a Radu Jude Dracula documentary, and a historical Palestine film; Case and Trent bicker about genre trends and geopolitics.

segments.title: Chet Segment: AI Sitcom Slop, Sympathetic Period Farts, Neo Robot
segments.notes: Chet appears unprompted, discusses his Chat Your Bait girlfriend LexiPro, reacts to viral videos, and covers the Wall Street Journal report on 1X's Neo humanoid robot — a $20k teleoperated home robot slated for 2026 delivery.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate: Kristi Noem — Freddy Krueger or Jeffrey Dahmer?
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether Kristi Noem resembles Freddy Krueger or Jeffrey Dahmer, triggered by JD Vance's comments on dog abuse; Crum references the Join the Wall arc ('hell crumb is me') and threatens a 'kill shot' on Munch.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Interrupts and Raid to Bruce Green
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon emerges from the walls to disrupt the sign-off; Case raids Bruce Green's channel as the broadcast ends.

characters.notes: musical/cultural correspondent. Hijacked pre-show with a freestyle rap about 'piss webs' and piss spiders for Halloween.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted news desk covering refugee cap, Sudan, Prince Andrew, Cash Patel, NZXT lawsuit, and Saudi sky stadium; endured HR toilet bit and last-name poll resulting in 'Wet Mitchell.'

characters.name: Trent

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's Halloween sign-on before Case and Kendall derailed into One Piece trivia and a Pink Panther costume reveal, interrupted by Hype Train's 'piss webs' freestyle. The news desk covered Trump's record-low refugee cap targeting white South Africans, the Sudan humanitarian crisis, Prince Andrew's eviction, Cash Patel's government jet misuse, and Saudi Arabia's sky stadium render. Trent's Trailer Thursday screened four films, Chet commandeered the broadcast to discuss his AI girlfriend and 1X's teleoperated Neo robot, and Munch & Crum debated whether Kristi Noem resembles Freddy Krueger or Jeffrey Dahmer — ending with Crum invoking his hell tenure and threatening a kill shot. Peter Gibbon closed the broadcast with a wall intrusion and a raid to Bruce Green.
